mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.nickname, profile.media_url AS profile_image_url, m.title, m.introduction, m.mood, m.access_level, m.created_at, bgm.media_url AS bgm_url, m.background_color, background.media_url AS background_image_url FROM minihompy m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN media bgm ON bgm.media_id = m.media_id LEFT JOIN media profile ON profile.target_type = 'PROFILE' AND profile.target_id = m.user_id AND profile.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN media background ON background.target_type = 'BACKGROUND' AND background.target_id = m.user_id AND background.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE m.user_id = #{ownerId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO minihompy (user_id, title, introduction, mood, access_level, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{introduction}, #{mood}, #{accessLevel}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT minihompy_id FROM minihompy WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE minihompy SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
